session_note: The NC General Assembly's 2025-2026 biennium (2025 long session running continuously into a 2026 short/reconvened session) had NOT adjourned sine die as of 2026-07-31 -- ncleg.gov shows the House and Senate scheduled to convene again 2026-08-03, with active 2026 budget conference activity (conference report 2026-06-30) and a pending governor veto matter (H.B. 437), so bills that sat in a House or Senate committee since 2025 with no further recorded action are still alive/pending (carried over), not dead. By contrast, the separate 2023-2024 biennium concluded before the 2025-2026 General Assembly convened in January 2025; any bill filed under that earlier session number that never passed is dead by adjournment, since NC bill numbers and carryover apply only within a single two-year biennium, not across bienniums.
